metadata.name: LobeChat
metadata.summary: A chatbot interface that keeps chats in each browser, behind an access code.

zh-CN.summary: LobeChat 以非 root 身份运行，根文件系统只读，应用 restricted 级别的 Pod Security。它没有 Kubernetes 令牌，Ingress 使用 TLS。对外连接没有限制。

zh-TW.summary: LobeChat 以非 root 身分執行，根檔案系統唯讀，套用 restricted 等級的 Pod Security。它沒有 Kubernetes 權杖，Ingress 使用 TLS。對外連線沒有限制。

zh-CN.mitigation: 模板说明里有写明许可证。模板运行的是未经修改的镜像，声明都完整保留。要分发衍生作品之前，请先取得商业授权许可。

zh-TW.mitigation: 範本說明裡有寫明授權。範本執行的是未經修改的映像檔，聲明都完整保留。要散布衍生作品之前，請先取得商業授權許可。
zh-TW.risk: LobeHub 社群授權限制你散布衍生作品的方式。

risks.mitigation: The template description names the license. The template runs the unmodified image with its notices intact. Get commercial permission before you distribute a derivative.
risks.risk: The LobeHub Community License limits how you may distribute derivative works.

zh-CN.mitigation: 只把部署分享给彼此信任的用户。访问码是高强度随机生成的，上游的登录保护已开启，Ingress 只允许 TLS 连接。
zh-CN.risk: 知道共用访问码的人，都会共用同一个实例和同一把模型密钥，费用由服务器这边承担。

zh-TW.mitigation: 只把部署分享給彼此信任的使用者。存取碼是高強度隨機產生的，上游的登入保護已開啟，Ingress 只允許 TLS 連線。
zh-TW.risk: 知道共用存取碼的人，都會共用同一個實例和同一把模型金鑰，費用由伺服器這邊負擔。

risks.mitigation: Share a deployment only with users who trust each other. The code is generated with high entropy, the upstream sign-in protection is on, and ingress allows TLS only.
risks.risk: Everyone who knows the shared access code uses the same instance and the same model key, and the server pays for it.

security.summary: LobeChat runs as non-root with a read-only root filesystem and the restricted Pod Security level. It has no Kubernetes token, and ingress uses TLS. Outbound traffic is not limited.

manifests:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: lobechat
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: lobechat
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: lobechat
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        templates.zeabur.com/template: lobechat
        app.kubernetes.io/name: lobechat
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1001
        runAsGroup: 1001
        fsGroup: 1001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
      - name: lobechat
        image: docker.io/lobehub/lobe-chat:1.143.3@sha256:b2d2454525523d9f0a19c79661f83ec45f13363dbadd5c1180887e77af35d872
        ports:
        - name: http
          containerPort: 3210
        env:
        - name: ACCESS_CODE
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: lobechat-secrets
              key: access-code
        - name: OPENAI_API_KEY
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: '{{ .Inputs.providerSecret }}'
              key: api-key
        - name: ENABLE_AUTH_PROTECTION
          value: '1'
        - name: APP_URL
          value: https://{{ .Domain }}
        - name: HOSTNAME
          value: 0.0.0.0
        - name: PORT
          value: '3210'
        - name: SSRF_ALLOW_PRIVATE_IP_ADDRESS
          value: '0'
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 256Mi
          limits:
            cpu: '2'
            memory: 2Gi
        volumeMounts:
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
        - name: cache
          mountPath: /app/.next/cache
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 3
          failureThreshold: 6
        livenessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 3
          failureThreshold: 6
        startupProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 3
          failureThreshold: 30
      volumes:
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 1Gi
      - name: cache
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 512Mi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: lobechat
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: lobechat
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: lobechat
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 3210
    targetPort: http
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: lobechat
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: lobechat
  annotations:
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: '{{ .ClusterIssuer }}'
    traefik.ingress.kubernetes.io/router.entrypoints: websecure
spec:
  ingressClassName: traefik
  tls:
  - hosts:
    - '{{ .Domain }}'
    secretName: lobechat-tls
  rules:
  - host: '{{ .Domain }}'
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: lobechat
            port:
              name: http
